We tried to stop them, but they left the outpost.|A [[Unidentified clone trooper (Devaron)|clone trooper]] at the Devaron outpost reports to [[Anakin Skywalker]]|}} An '''outpost''' was located on the jungle [[planet]] [[Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. It existed in conjunction with the [[Temple of Eedit]], a [[Jedi temple]] that served as a separate Republic outpost. ==History== During the [[Clone Wars]], [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]] [[Battle of Devaron|besieged]] the [[Galactic Republic]] outpost on [[Devaron]] with an attack force from the [[Trade Federation]]. Bane captured [[Jedi General]] [[Bolla Ropal]], as well as the [[Kyber memory crystal]] that Ropal held in his possession. ==Behind the scenes== Within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the Republic outpost briefly seen in "[[Cargo of Doom]]" and the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] from "[[Monster]]" were confirmed to be the same facility. Both locations were derived from the same production artwork, entitled "Devaron Jedi outpost."[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] However, in official [[canon]], the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (2014-)|Databank's]] entry on Devaron indicated that the two locations were separate.{{Databank|devaron|Devaron}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}} {{1st}} *''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' {{Ab|Aftermath: Empire's End (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *{{Databank|devaron|Devaron}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Puesto de avanzada de la Nueva República en Devaron |pl=Baza Republiki Galaktycznej na Devaronie}} [[Category:Devaron locations]] [[Category:Galactic Republic military bases]] [[Category:Imperial military bases]] [[Category:New Republic military bases]]
